title: Save order of task manager when manually sorted
line: Tasks you sort by hand in the Task Manager now keep their order after plasmashell restarts and when the apps are opened again.
explanation: With manual sorting, TasksModel only kept its sort map in memory; launchers were the only tasks whose position was saved (through the launcher list). After a plasmashell restart, or when apps were opened again after login, window tasks came back in whatever order the window system listed them. TasksModel now has a manualAppOrder property: every move() writes the app ids of the tasks in their current order (keeping installed apps that are closed after the app they followed, at most 50 entries), and new tasks are sorted in front of the first task that comes after them in that list. The Task Manager widget stores the list in its config and sets it back on startup.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: remember the manual order of tasks

With manual sorting only launchers kept their position, so the order of
other tasks was lost on restart. Moving a task now saves the app order,
and a reopened app goes back to its old place instead of the end.

BUG: 389649

applets/taskmanager: save the manual order of tasks

The order of tasks sorted manually was only kept until plasmashell
restarted. The widget now stores the app order exposed by the tasks
model in its config and gives it back on startup, restoring the order.

BUG: 389649

patches.diff:
From 6fa1be1bc3ccbe21e0fb089a8a24eeae475171b6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:20:53 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: save the manual order of tasks

The order of tasks sorted manually was only kept until plasmashell
restarted. The widget now stores the app order exposed by the tasks
model in its config and gives it back on startup, restoring the order.

BUG: 389649
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml     | 4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml | 5 +++++
 2 files changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..d515bb45e4 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -106,6 +106,10 @@
       <label>The list of launcher tasks on the widget. Usually .desktop file or executable URLs. Special URLs such as preferred://browser that expand to default applications are supported.</label>
       <default>applications:systemsettings.desktop,applications:org.kde.discover.desktop,preferred://filemanager,preferred://browser</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="manualAppOrder" type="StringList">
+      <label>The app ids of tasks in the order they were last sorted in manually, used to restore that order.</label>
+      <default></default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="middleClickAction" type="Enum">
       <label>What to do on middle-mouse click on a task button.</label>
       <choices>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..a6cf21601b 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -190,6 +190,11 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             Plasmoid.configuration.launchers = launcherList;
         }
 
+        manualAppOrder: Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder
+        onManualAppOrderChanged: {
+            Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder = manualAppOrder;
+        }
+
         onGroupingAppIdBlacklistChanged: {
             Plasmoid.configuration.groupingAppIdBlacklist = groupingAppIdBlacklist;
         }
--

media.caption: Before: after restarting plasmashell the order is lost (Konsole, Mousepad, xterm)
Before: after closing the apps and opening them again as Konsole, Mousepad, xterm, they stay in that order
After: restarting plasmashell keeps Mousepad, xterm, Konsole
After: opened again as Konsole, Mousepad, xterm, they go back to Mousepad, xterm, Konsole

review.text: Reasonable architecture for persisting manual task order via a new TasksModel::manualAppOrder property and Task Manager config entry, with clear documentation of the reopen behavior change. However, there is a functional bug in the installed-app pruning check (KService::serviceByDesktopName() fails on real '*.desktop' AppId values), a two-way QML binding loop and initialization-order issue in main.qml, and unnecessary KService/config churn on every intermediate drag step.
changes: Replace KService::serviceByDesktopName(appId) with KService::serviceByStorageId(appId) in TasksModel::Private::updateManualAppOrder() (and explicitly #include <KService> in tasksmodel.cpp): AbstractTasksModel::AppId for desktop-backed apps is KService::storageId() (ending in '.desktop'), for which serviceByDesktopName() returns nullptr and would silently drop closed installed apps on the next move(). Re-verify by closing a real app and then dragging other open tasks.

In plasma-desktop/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml, remove the declarative binding 'manualAppOrder: Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder' (which forms a two-way loop with onManualAppOrderChanged and runs before launcherList is loaded) and assign 'manualAppOrder = Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder;' in Component.onCompleted after launcherList, matching launcherList and grouping*Blacklist.

Avoid running updateManualAppOrder() (up to 50 KService lookups and a config write) on every intermediate drag step, launcher move, or intra-group move in TasksModel::move() — skip when isLauncherMove or parent.isValid(), and ideally flush/sync on drag completion alongside syncLaunchers().

Add unit tests in tasksmodeltest covering manualAppOrder (save on move, restore on restart/insertion, pruning uninstalled and >50 closed entries, excluding launchers) and use CCBUG: 389649 on the plasma-workspace commit so the bug is only closed once the plasma-desktop MR also lands.

reviews.text: The direction is right: TasksModel keeps the order in memory, the applet saves it in its config like the launcher list, and before-2/after-2 and before-3/after-3 show the restart and reopen cases fixed. But the new order is written from move(), which runs many times during one drag, so the config is rewritten on every step instead of once when the drop is committed (as syncLaunchers() does for launchers). New tasks are only placed when rowsInserted fires, so a Wayland window whose AppId is set or corrected later (or a window still queued with SkipTaskbar) never moves to its saved place. In !separateLaunchers mode, moving rows in sortedPreFilterRows also changes the row positions that sortRowInsertQueue still points to. A behaviour change this large in libtaskmanager has no autotest, and before-1/after-1 are the same picture.
changes: Update manualAppOrder once when the drag is committed (with syncLaunchers() or a similar commit call from the applet), not inside every move()

Re-sort a task by manualAppOrder when its AppId changes after insertion, or when it leaves the SkipTaskbar insert queue, and keep sortRowInsertQueue positions valid when sortInByManualAppOrder moves rows
Add tasksmodeltest cases for setManualAppOrder + insertion order, the 50-entry limit and grouped windows
Drop the duplicate before-1/after-1 pair from the MR table; rebase against the 424836 change, which also edits TasksModel::move()
